scope: Applicability review of the management frontend runtime npm audit result; not an all-language vulnerability audit or penetration test

verified_application_structure.routing: orchestrator/web/src/App.tsx uses BrowserRouter, Routes and fixed Route declarations (Declarative Mode)
verified_application_structure.rendering: orchestrator/web/src/main.tsx uses createRoot; no SSR hydration or RSC entry
verified_application_structure.server: orchestrator/internal/server/router.go spaMiddleware serves static files/index.html; APIs are native Go handlers, not React Router server actions, single-fetch or manifest endpoints
verified_application_structure.navigation: Reviewed all Link/LinkButton/Navigate/useNavigate consumers in orchestrator/web/src. Destinations are fixed internal routes or fixed /apps/, /stream-sessions, /components and /docs prefixes with IDs/query/hash values. No caller passes a raw attacker-supplied full navigation target. Login returns to fixed /, not location.state.from.

advisories.requirement: Framework Mode and an existing application prototype pollution path
advisories.assessment: Upstream explicitly excludes Declarative Mode; current application does not expose this server execution path
Upstream explicitly excludes Declarative Mode; no such handler in native management server
Upstream explicitly excludes Declarative Mode; native Go APIs do not use the affected serializer

advisories.requirement: Framework Mode document action CSRF checks
advisories.assessment: Upstream explicitly excludes Declarative Mode; no framework document actions

advisories.requirement: Attacker-supplied paths passed to navigation mechanisms
advisories.assessment: Potentially relevant to client routing; current caller review found no raw untrusted full navigation target. Fixed route prefixes are application evidence, not a patch to the affected dependency
No RSC APIs or RSC application entry

advisories.requirement: Framework Mode or manual Data Mode SSR/hydration with attacker-modified error fields
advisories.assessment: Upstream explicitly excludes Declarative Mode; createRoot performs client rendering without hydration
Upstream explicitly excludes Declarative Mode; not evidence of native service resource exhaustion

advisories.requirement: Untrusted input to framework redirect function
advisories.assessment: Upstream explicitly excludes Declarative Mode; no application redirect-function caller
No RSC APIs or framework action execution in this application

decision: No currently exposed vector identified for these ten advisories from upstream conditions and current caller review. Preserve the frozen viewport-fix candidate while completing deployment; retain the dependency upgrade as maintenance debt. Do not represent npm audit as clean or the package as patched. Any new server rendering, RSC, data-router actions or arbitrary navigation must trigger reassessment before release.
remaining: Development dependency advisories, native Rust/Go/C++ dependencies and future advisories are outside this bounded review. No comprehensive-security completion claim.
